title: Auckland policy analysis grid
geographic_scope: Auckland, New Zealand — real coordinates, modelled zone system
notes: Input world state for GOV SIM. The grid is anchored on Auckland's real centre so it registers against the OpenStreetMap basemap, but the zone system, population, jobs and trip figures are modelled — not measured, and not drawn from any administrative record. Numeric effects are produced later by the simulation engine, never by an LLM (SPEC §34).
